context.en: Emperor Wen organized the Han response to the 166 BCE incursion. This Song-period portrait presents the ruler centuries later.
context.zh: 汉文帝组织了对前166年入边的应对。这幅宋代肖像呈现的是后世对他的描绘。

context.en: Cao Cao selected the surrendered troops described in this entry. His portrait in the 1609 Sancai Tuhui belongs to his later commemorative image.
context.zh: 曹操是本条所述选编降卒的主持者。1609年《三才图会》中的肖像，属于其后世纪念形象。

context.en: Liu Xiu became emperor south of Hao before establishing his capital at Luoyang. This later court image identifies the ruler in that two-part story.
context.zh: 刘秀先在鄗南即位，再定都洛阳。后世宫廷图像呈现了这段两地叙事中的君主。

context.en: Emperor Yang ordered construction of the eastern capital and Tongji Canal in 605. The later imperial portrait identifies the sponsor of those works.
context.zh: 隋炀帝于605年下令营建东京、开通济渠。后世帝王肖像呈现了这些工程的发起者。

context.en: The besieged emperor in the 615 Yanmen episode was Yang Guang. The scroll depicts the ruler in a later imperial portrait tradition.
context.zh: 615年雁门之围中的皇帝为杨广。画卷以其后形成的帝王肖像传统呈现这位君主。

context.en: This nineteenth-century portrait identifies Lin Zexu, the commissioner who supervised the destruction of opium at Humen.
context.zh: 这幅19世纪肖像呈现了主持虎门销烟的钦差大臣林则徐。

context.en: Nurhaci led the unsuccessful attack on Ningyuan. His formal court portrait presents a different setting from the battle described here.
context.zh: 努尔哈赤率军进攻宁远而受挫。正式朝服肖像呈现了与本条战事不同的场合。
